cases.setup: Use each exact configured1835/Otis and1904/Hans row with a deferred makeAssembly and native createTownTransport; no actor loaded.
cases.act: Request the named driver approach, then use the existing ensureNear/ready path and resolve the assembly normally.
assertions: Anchor lookup and approach request themselves acquire no model and do not mutate the camera.
Exactly the intended row/person actor is stopped with reason approach before onActorsChanged and before any lastUpdate replay.
Advance at least2 unpaused native seconds after ready: same route distance/wheel distance remain stopped while the independently qualified seated look may advance.
Actual named identity is preserved; no default/fallback person or duplicate standing driver body is introduced.

cases.setup: Drive the real extracted goToTarget with a cold eligible named driver anchor and a safe existing4m side stand; travel.go records its existing callback argument.
cases.act: Begin Find; allow the existing lazy load to finish after the camera journey begins or after instant-mode arrival.
assertions: Destination remains the exact existing route/seat side-stand computation with existing router blockedAt guard.
The named actor actually stops after load; merely reaching/teleporting to the destination doesnot satisfy this case.
No new route, direct walker teleport, asset load, speed, budget or safe-stand clearance shortcut is added.

cases.setup: Queue cold Find and defer assembly creation.
cases.act: Cancel its travel through the existing onStop path before resolving the assembly.
assertions: The later actor retains its ordinary original moving/saved state, with no stale approach stop.
Repeat for manual input, MoveStop, unreachable route and travel.go false/throw; cancellation is idempotent.

cases.setup: Request same named person twice, retain both handles, and leave assembly deferred.
cases.act: Invoke the old cancellation callback after the newer request; then resolve load.
assertions: The newer request is fulfilled and stops the intended actor before publication.
A canceled request for one person cannot remove another person route request.
After a new valid different destination begins, main clears unresolved old requests without resuming fulfilled stops.
An invalid/blocked proposed destination that never starts navigation doesnot cancel the existing valid pending rendezvous.

cases.setup: Fulfill a pending Find or request a live actual driver so it stops immediately; register existing transport Interact adapter.
cases.act: Cancel the old approach handle, invoke existing Continue with clearance blocked, then clear visitor and invoke Continue; later invoke Stop.
assertions: Cancel never calls resume and never changes an actual stopped driver state.
Blocked Continue retains stopped and Step back offer; clear Continue resumes exactly once through canResume.
After Continue no residual pending request re-stops the actor.
KeyboardR and the same touch/click button continue to use the original engine, without new handlers.

cases.setup: Load and stop a named driver, preserving native distance, wheel rotations and identity.
cases.act: SwitchFull/Balanced toLight then restore; invoke any old canceled handle afterrestore.
assertions: Light keeps original zero moving-model reach and model-release behaviour.
Restored journey remains stopped at its saved actual distance/wheel state and retains same named identity.
No duplicate standing/model ownership or unwanted resume occurs.

cases.setup: Queue a cold approach and defer makeAssembly, then change toLight/generation and back to eligible tier using existing lifecycle.
cases.act: Resolve the retired-generation assembly, then the current-generation assembly; run variant cancel whileLight.
assertions: Retired generation disposes its assembly before actor creation/registration and never consumes current pending intent.
If request remains active, only the current generation fulfills it.
If canceled whileLight, the new actor follows original moving/saved state with no approach leak.

cases.setup: Queue request and defer parse; dispose old town layer; construct a separate new layer with same or different person IDs.
cases.act: Resolve old parse and invoke old cancel handle after a new-layer request.
assertions: Disposed layer publishes no actor and old assembly is disposed by existing guard.
Old pending map is empty and cannot affect the new layer request.
Ordinary pagehide/year scene teardown keeps original model/body release behaviour.

cases.setup: Use unknown person, wrongyear, mismatched driver_instance person, unselectable driver, missing driverasset andLight tier.

assertions: Request isnull or follows existing named-person fallback only; no pending intent for an ineligible/unavailable driver.
No GLB/assembly import is forced by an anchor/request lookup.
Blocked safe side stands do not queue an approach or relocate a record.

assertions: Recoverable deferral preserves active intent until successful current actor creation.
A fatal row clears its unresolved approach request and retains the original failed-row/no automatic retry behavior.
No route-ground/support/source failure is reclassified as recoverable.
